verdict.rationale: Postman's docs explicitly describe creating mock servers to simulate a real API server 'that's always available to handle requests,' including deploying mocks and creating dynamic mock responses, which directly enables consumers to build against an API before it exists. This is well-documented first-party functionality (mock server setup guide), though there's no independent/hands-on corroboration in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of mock server usage and explicit tie-in to generating mocks directly from OpenAPI spec import.
